title: US recession odds near 50%: Can Bitcoin copy 2020 comeback gains?
summary: US recession fears multiplied this week as BlackRock's Larry Fink warned of a "global" downturn over oil prices, with Bitcoin still tied to stocks.

title: CoinShares says up to 20% of Bitcoin miners are unprofitable
summary: CoinShares says up to 20% of Bitcoin miners may be unprofitable at current hashprice levels, particularly those running older machines or paying higher power costs.

title: Fenbushi co-founder offers bounty to recover $42M lost in 2022 hack
summary: Investigators have frozen about $1.2 million as efforts continue to trace funds lost in a wallet breach linked to a seed phrase compromise.

title: UK pushes ahead with temporary ban on political crypto donations
summary: The government plans to implement the ban by amending the Representation of the People Bill, with changes taking "retrospective effect" from Wednesday.

title: Coinbase opposes stablecoin compromise in Senate crypto bill: Report
summary: Coinbase is reportedly still pushing back against stablecoin yield provisions in the Senate’s crypto market structure bill, a move that has derailed past efforts to advance the legislation.

title: Proposed bill seeks to ban US president, Congress from prediction markets
summary: The bill adds to a wave of recent legislative and state-level actions targeting prediction markets as scrutiny over sports betting, war contracts and alleged insider trading builds.

title: Bitcoin’s quantum-resistance lag may become Ethereum’s bull case: Nic Carter
summary: Crypto entrepreneur Nic Carter claims that Bitcoin developers still have their "head in the sand" when it comes to making Bitcoin quantum-resistant, compared to Ethereum.

title: Swan Bitcoin seeks to subpoena Cantor Fitzgerald, ex-CEO in ex-staff dispute
summary: Swan Bitcoin claims that Howard Lutnick may have known about its failed Tether mining venture, after which employees allegedly stole documents, resigned and launched a rival firm.

title: Australia's central bank backs tokenization as pilot finds $16.7B upside
summary: Tokenized finance and related infrastructure upgrades could be “revolutionary,” according to industry advocates cited by the Reserve Bank of Australia.

title: Bitcoin Depot picks ex-MoneyGram boss as CEO as state actions mount
summary: Former MoneyGram veteran Alex Holmes is now leading Bitcoin Depot, as crypto ATM operators face mounting legal scrutiny in multiple US states.
